## Cost analysis

Current live/baseline `thisray-4808` task009 is cost 115441 = memory 111600 + params 3841. The expensive params are the 900x4 GatherND index plus two 10x10 triangular span matrices; the largest memory terms are the 10-channel delta concat (36000), 9-channel painted mask (32400), and float/bool 9x10x10 span intermediates.

The v4 candidate removes the large GatherND index and triangular matrices by using a 2x2/stride-3 MaxPool over the padded one-hot input for macro-cell extraction, then directional MaxPool for row/column spans. Computing vertical spans directly on `[N,9,10,10]` avoids the previous transpose-to-column and transpose-back intermediates, dropping memory to 107500 and params to 41 for total cost 107541.

The `fresh_where` scratch model (cost 104847) replaces the live's Neg+Concat+Add reconstruction with Where(ReduceMax>0, Pad(v22,prepend_ch0), input). Savings: removes v24[1,1,30,30]=3600B and v25[1,10,30,30]=36000B, adds span_flag[1,1,30,30]=900B and span_color[1,10,30,30]=36000B → net -2700B memory; adds pads_init 8-int64 init → +8 params. Net: -2694 cost. The live model's Neg+Concat+Add approach produces -1.0 in ch0 for span cells (benign under argmax scoring but technically incorrect float output).
